digest.component_or_area: documentation and guidance for operation certificates and manifest signing
propositions: Guidance in maintained documentation conflates generic HMAC manifest signatures with current asymmetric operation certificates defined in ADR 0044 and ADR 0049
Current plan-review and completion-verifier statements must identify all four implementation facts: DSSE envelope, SSHSIG signing, Ed25519 key, and environment-attributed signer identity
Legacy HMAC compatibility statements must explicitly state that pre-migration records remain readable but cannot certify current gated operations
Generic HMAC manifest/API guidance for non-gate consumers must be preserved while fixing incorrect gate-consumer attribution in docs/reuse-surface.md
Seven specific documentation files require reclassification and update while preserving ADR history, migration evidence, and existing test contracts
All gate-adjacent signature references across the codebase must be classified by consumer role and edited scope to eliminate omissions
